reader.notes: Each lettered item has its arm: a and e in SortAddFileKeys and Violation, c in Violation's shape arm, d by key windows applied to every record image, f by the VaryMin comparison. The messages letter the items by the 2023 rule (b/f, d, g) where 1985 letters them e, c, f. The 1985 concepts call record descriptions of files sharing a SAME RECORD AREA associated; SR4 a's records associated with file-name-1 is read as the SD's own records, and a peer file's item is refused.
